02592 Channiy'el {khan-nee-ale'}

源自 02603 和 0410; 陽性專有名詞 人名

AV - Haniel 1, Hanniel 1; 2

漢聶(#民 34:23|) 或 漢尼業(#代上 7:39|) = "上帝恩寵的"
1) 以弗的兒子, 瑪拿西支派的首領(#民 34:23|)
2) 烏拉的兒子, 亞設支派的首領 (#代上 7:39|)
record.edic_text:
02592 Channiy'el {khan-nee-ale'}

from 02603 and 0410;; n pr m

AV - Haniel 1, Hanniel 1; 2

Hanniel = "favoured of God"
1) son of Ephod and a prince of the tribe of Manasseh
2) son of Ulla and a chief of the tribe of Asher; also 'Haniel'
